structure: Confluence page 'Requirements catalogue'. Opens with an info macro pointing to a SharePoint Excel requirements template (out of scope: administrative pointer, not a requirement). Main body is one H1, 'Notification Data Requirements (required for risk assessing/inspection planning)', with an info macro giving context (data captured by NNS re: commodity type; a currency caveat naming two policy contacts). Under that H1 are three H4 subsections, each a flat bullet list: 'Potatoes (seed and ware)' (7 items, out of scope per sources.json), 'All other goods' (11 items, in scope), and 'Additional caveats for wood products' (4 items, in scope as the All-other-goods list's caveats). The wood-products caveats list four specific wood/tree product-and-origin combinations verbatim but never states, on this page, what obligation or extra data requirement attaches to matching one — that linkage is a gap.

claims.statement: The data captured by NNS about a consignment's commodity type is required for risk assessing and inspection planning.
claims.ref: H1 'Notification Data Requirements (required for risk assessing/inspection planning)'; info macro body
claims.quote: Notification Data Requirements (required for risk assessing/inspection planning) ... Data to be captured by NNS in relation to commodity type.

claims.statement: The Notification Data Requirements list is stated as accurate only at the time the page was published, and the reader should contact one of two named policy leads for an up-to-date list.
claims.ref: H1 section info macro, second paragraph
claims.quote: True at time of publishing - contact Kate Somerwill-Owens and/or Heather Brittlebank (policy) for an accurate up to date list.

claims.statement: For all other goods (non-potato), the notification must give the expected date of landing in Great Britain of the consignment, or, if the consignment has already arrived, the date it first arrived in Great Britain.
claims.quote: the expected date of landing in GB of the consignment or, if the consignment has arrived in Great Britain, the date on which it first arrived in Great Britain

claims.statement: The notification must give the intended destination of the consignment, or, if the consignment has already arrived at its intended destination in Great Britain, its current location.
claims.quote: the intended destination of the consignment, or if the consignment has arrived at its intended destination in Great Britain, its current location

claims.statement: The notification must give the category of goods (for example plants for planting or cut wood), and the genus and species for plants for planting.
claims.quote: the category (e.g. plants for planting or cut wood), genus, species (for plants for planting)

claims.statement: The notification must give the commodity code of the relevant goods in the consignment.
claims.quote: The Commodity code of the relevant goods,  in the consignment

claims.statement: The notification must give the quantity of the relevant goods in the consignment. The source refers to 'the relevant goods, as detailed in paragraph 1' without that paragraph being present on this page.
claims.quote: The quantity of the relevant goods, as detailed in paragraph 1, in the consignment

claims.statement: The notification must give the country from which the plants or wood originate.
claims.quote: the country from which the plants or wood originate

claims.statement: The notification must give the name and address of the consignor.
claims.quote: the name and address of the consignor

claims.statement: Where the goods are plants intended for planting, the notification must additionally give the identification number of the supplier of the plants and the EPPO code for the plants.
claims.quote: in the case of plants intended for planting, the identification number of the supplier of the plants and the EPPO code for the plants

claims.statement: Where the goods are cut trees or trees for planting, the notification must additionally give the size of the tree.
claims.quote: in the case of cut trees or trees for planting, the size of the tree

claims.statement: Where the goods are wood and wood products (including isolated bark), the notification must additionally confirm what phytosanitary treatments have been applied.
claims.quote: in the case of wood and wood products (including isolated bark), confirmation of what phytosanitary treatments have been applied

claims.statement: The notification may optionally give the intended use of the goods.

One of the wood-product/origin combinations subject to the additional caveats for wood products is conifer wood with bark and isolated bark of conifer from an EU member state, excluding preservative-treated wood.
claims.ref: H4 'Additional caveats for wood products', item 1
claims.quote: Conifer wood with bark and isolated bark of conifer from an EU member state, excluding preservative-treated wood

claims.statement: One of the wood-product/origin combinations subject to the additional caveats for wood products is conifer wood with or without bark and isolated bark from Italy, France, Portugal or Spain, excluding preservative-treated wood.
claims.ref: H4 'Additional caveats for wood products', item 2
claims.quote: Conifer wood with or without bark and isolated bark from Italy, France, Portugal and Spain, excluding preservative-treated wood

claims.statement: One of the wood-product/origin combinations subject to the additional caveats for wood products is cut coniferous trees over 3 metres in height from an EU member state.
claims.ref: H4 'Additional caveats for wood products', item 3
claims.quote: Cut coniferous trees > 3 metres in height from an EU member state

claims.statement: One of the wood-product/origin combinations subject to the additional caveats for wood products is wood of Fraxinus, Castanea, Juglans, Pterocarya or Platanus from an EU member state, excluding preservative-treated wood, that either retains all or part of its natural round surface (with or without bark) or is in the form of chips that have not undergone processing into pellets or briquettes.
claims.ref: H4 'Additional caveats for wood products', item 4
claims.quote: Wood, of Fraxinus, Castanea, Juglans, Pterocarya and Platanus from an EU member state excluding preservative-treated wood, that: - retains all or part of its natural round surface, with or without bark - is in the form of chips which have not undergone processing to produce pellets or briquettes

claims.statement: The page lists four wood-product/origin combinations under 'Additional caveats for wood products' but does not state, on this page, what obligation, extra data field or process step attaches to a consignment matching one of them.
claims.ref: H4 'Additional caveats for wood products' (whole subsection, heading vs. body)
